title: Sequencing: document exhibition
bodyMd:
Five original documents are shown in a numbered row, from position one to position five.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Accord, Bill, Code, Deed, Edict.

- Code must occupy position 1 or position 5.
- Accord must precede Deed.
- Bill and Edict must not occupy consecutive positions.
- Exactly 1 other item must occur between Accord and Bill.
